notes: Decisions are made at each UTC hour boundary using only data available by then.
Perp prices come from the 1-second event grid; spot, premium index and funding from Binance archives.
Metrics snapshots are used only if at least publication_lag old and at most max_age stale.
Entry is one minute after the decision; horizons are measured from entry.
Carry-inclusive targets subtract funding paid by a long position at settlements inside the holding window.
Returns and premium/basis/funding features are in bps; open-interest changes are in percent.
Binance's archive lacks the top-trader ratio for 87% of 2022 and the taker ratio for 35%; those ratio features are set to 0 (neutral) when missing.
Forecast regressions are fitted on the preceding 12 months with a horizon embargo and frozen for each test month.
